headline: China releases a progress report on its AI capacity-building plan
summary: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it released a two-year progress report on its AI Capacity-Building Inclusive Plan at the Xiong'an Global Governance Forum on October 23, 2026. In a later official briefing, a spokesperson said the report summarizes cooperation results, experience and cases, and emphasizes coordinated supply of AI models, data and talent. The full report and its project-level evidence were not available in this review. The announcement establishes a policy-report release and official framing; it does not establish project delivery, partner-country uptake or measured outcomes.
